text:
anne: heads-up: starting v2-sampler deploy in ~30m. target service: sampler-api. Feature flag: new_sampler_enabled. Ramp plan below.
deploy-bot: queued release v2.1 to sampler-api-canary.
miguel: ack. I'll watch canary metrics (error-rate, p95 latency).
sara: i'll own dashboards + alerting. set thresholds: error_rate > 1.5% or p95 delta > 300ms -> rollback.
anne: plan: T+0m enable dry-run, T+10m -> 2% cohort, T+30m -> 10% (two cohorts), T+75m -> 50%, T+105m -> 100%. each step: 10m soak + smoke checks. canaries pinned to image v2.1-canary.
tiernan: can we pin routing/model to v2.1 for cohorts? want deterministic comparisons.
anne: yes, pins set. rollout config below.
```json
{"flag":"new_sampler_enabled","cohorts":[{"pct":2,"targets":"cohort-a"},{"pct":10,"targets":"cohort-b"},{"pct":50,"targets":"all"}],"pins":{"canary":"v2.1-canary","stable":"v2.0"},"rollback_conditions":{"error_rate_gt":"1.5%","p95_increase_ms":"300"}}
```
deploy-bot: release queued: sampler-api v2.1 -> canary.
sara: added grafana dashboards to watchlist: sampler/errors, sampler/p95, sampler/throughput.
miguel: quick sanity: will run smoke with -n 200 reqs.
anne: smoke command:
```bash
ab -n 200 -c 10 https://canary.sampler.redwood/api/sample
```
miguel: smoke looks fine locally :thumbsup:.
deploy-bot: toggled new_sampler_enabled -> 2% (cohort-a). logs:
```
[2026-03-23T03:10:12Z] flag=new_sampler_enabled pct=2 rollout=cohort-a target=canary
```
sara: initial 10m soak: error_rate 0.2%, p95 delta +40ms — OK.
tiernan: keeping pin to v2.1-canary for the 10% step.
anne: continue schedule. If anyone sees drift call rollback and mention @oncall.
miguel: noted, watching alert channel.
ops-bot: reminder: change window 03:00-05:00 UTC, ops oncall: @tiernan.
anne: thanks. will post concise release notes after 100% cutover.
sara: quick note — if we hit rollback, we should also unpin routing back to v2.0. deploy-bot will revert pins on rollback if triggered.
deploy-bot: toggled new_sampler_enabled -> 10% (cohort-b).
anne: next check-in in 25m then proceed to 50% unless alerts fire.
